statements.section: D.1 Logical spacetime volume and architectural assumptions
statements.markdown: candidate circuits and literature baselines are compared at matched system encodings and error budgets
statements.note: Appendix F.2 gives a lower-bound cost estimate for the Häner et al. baseline, whose estimated maximum error is about $10^{-6}$. The Lean candidate’s bound is $1.25\times10^{-7}$ on the valid input grid. In Appendix H.1, the dynamics baseline assigns $0.01$ to the ancilla-zero block error. The authors derive a bound of about $0.041$ for the baseline’s full-output error. The candidate’s full-output bound is $0.01$.
